title: Home practical guide and safety card: looking at soil
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Soils and aquatic plants (Flow and One Planet, Our World)
source: Written for science/y3 lesson 25 (Home practical guide and safety card: looking at soil (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 25: What is soil made of?. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To look closely at what soil is made of
equipment: A small trowel or old spoon
A sheet of white paper or a plate
safety: Wear gloves; do not touch your face
An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Ask an adult where you may dig a small hole
Put on gloves and take two spoonfuls of soil
Spread the soil thinly on the white paper
Sort what you find: bits of rock, dead leaves or roots, tiny animals
Put any animals back gently, then record your finds

questions.q: Big question: what would you find if you dug down deep?
questions.a: Dark topsoil with humus, then lighter subsoil and stones, then rock.
